name: SE2 Lie Group Implementation
definition: A class representing the SE2 Lie group (2D rigid body transformations) using a tangent parameterization of (vx, vy, omega) and an internal parameterization of (cos, sin, x, y).
summary: SE2 Lie Group Implementation parameterizes 2D rigid body transformations using a tangent parameterization, distinguishing itself by operating in 2D with translation components unlike 3D quaternion rotation.
